objetivo_oficial: OA 9: Comprender ideas generales e información explícita en textos adaptados y auténticos simples, impresos o digitales, sobre temas variados.

desafios.texto: Valparaíso is famous for its colourful houses on the hills. Visitors ride old funiculars called «ascensores» to go up. Many artists paint murals on the walls, so the city looks like an open-air museum.
desafios.enunciado: ¿Por qué es famosa Valparaíso según el texto?
alternativas: por sus casas de colores en los cerros
por sus playas de arena blanca
desafios.explicacion_error: «Famous for its colourful houses on the hills».

desafios.texto: Hi Tomás! I'm in Puerto Natales with my family. Yesterday we visited Torres del Paine. It was windy and cold, but the mountains were amazing. Tomorrow we're taking a boat to see a glacier. See you next week! – Sofía
desafios.enunciado: ¿Dónde está Sofía?
desafios.explicacion_error: «I'm in Puerto Natales with my family».

desafios.enunciado: Escucha. ¿Qué día es el examen?

audio.texto: Remember, the English test is on Friday.

desafios.pista: Escucha el día de la semana.

desafios.enunciado: ¿Verdadero, falso o no se menciona?

audio.texto: For tomorrow's class, please bring a dictionary.

desafios.explicacion_error: Dice: «bring a dictionary».

alternativas: porque hay muchos murales en las paredes

desafios.texto: Hi Tomás! I'm in Puerto Natales with my family. Yesterday we visited Torres del Paine. It was windy and cold, but the mountains were amazing. Tomorrow we're taking a boat to see a glacier. See you next week! – Sofía
desafios.enunciado: Ordena lo que hace Sofía.
elementos: take a boat to a glacier
desafios.pista: Fíjate en yesterday, now, tomorrow y next week.
desafios.explicacion_error: Ayer el parque, hoy escribe, mañana el bote y la próxima semana ve a Tomás.

desafios.enunciado: Escucha el aviso. ¿Por qué se suspende la salida?

audio.texto: The school trip is cancelled because of the heavy rain.

desafios.explicacion_error: Dice: «because of the heavy rain».

desafios.texto: Many teenagers sleep less than eight hours a night. Experts say this affects their memory and mood. Phones are part of the problem: the blue light from screens tells the brain that it is still daytime. A simple tip is to leave the phone outside the bedroom.
desafios.enunciado: What is the main idea of the text?
alternativas: Blue light is good for memory.
Teenagers don't sleep enough, and phones are part of the problem.
Experts sleep more than eight hours.
desafios.pista: La idea principal resume todo el texto, no un detalle.
desafios.explicacion_error: El texto habla de que los adolescentes duermen poco y del papel de los celulares.

desafios.texto: Many teenagers sleep less than eight hours a night. Experts say this affects their memory and mood. Phones are part of the problem: the blue light from screens tells the brain that it is still daytime. A simple tip is to leave the phone outside the bedroom.
desafios.enunciado: Blue light tells the brain that it is still ___.
desafios.explicacion_error: «Tells the brain that it is still daytime».

desafios.texto: Many teenagers sleep less than eight hours a night. Experts say this affects their memory and mood. Phones are part of the problem: the blue light from screens tells the brain that it is still daytime. A simple tip is to leave the phone outside the bedroom.
desafios.enunciado: Une cada parte del texto con su función.
pares: Many teenagers sleep less than eight hours.
Leave the phone outside the bedroom.
desafios.pista: Piensa en problema, consecuencia y solución.
desafios.explicacion_error: Primero el problema, luego su efecto y al final un consejo.

desafios.texto: The Atacama Desert is one of the driest places on Earth. Some areas haven't had rain for years. However, after a rare rainy winter, the desert can bloom with thousands of purple and pink flowers. People call this event «desierto florido».
desafios.enunciado: ¿Qué palabra muestra un contraste en el texto?
desafios.pista: Busca un conector que cambie la idea.
desafios.explicacion_error: «However» contrasta la sequía con la floración.

desafios.texto: The Atacama Desert is one of the driest places on Earth. Some areas haven't had rain for years. However, after a rare rainy winter, the desert can bloom with thousands of purple and pink flowers. People call this event «desierto florido».
desafios.enunciado: What can we infer about «desierto florido»?
alternativas: It happens in the south of Chile.
desafios.explicacion_error: Ocurre tras un invierno lluvioso poco común, así que no es todos los años.

desafios.texto: The Atacama Desert is one of the driest places on Earth. Some areas haven't had rain for years. However, after a rare rainy winter, the desert can bloom with thousands of purple and pink flowers. People call this event «desierto florido».
desafios.enunciado: ¿Cuál es el propósito del texto?
alternativas: dar una opinión sobre el clima
desafios.pista: ¿Qué hace el texto: informa, convence o narra?
desafios.explicacion_error: Explica qué es el desierto florido: informa.

objetivo_oficial: OA 10: Comprender textos no literarios (artículos, avisos, emails, páginas web, biografías, noticias) identificando propósito, idea principal, detalles, relaciones de contraste y problema-solución y vocabulario clave.

desafios.texto: LOST DOG – Have you seen Toby? He is a small brown dog with a red collar. He got lost near Plaza Ñuñoa on Saturday. If you find him, please call 9 1234 5678. Reward!
desafios.enunciado: What kind of text is this?
desafios.pista: Mira el título en mayúsculas y el teléfono.
desafios.explicacion_error: Es un aviso (notice) de perro perdido.

desafios.texto: LOST DOG – Have you seen Toby? He is a small brown dog with a red collar. He got lost near Plaza Ñuñoa on Saturday. If you find him, please call 9 1234 5678. Reward!
desafios.enunciado: Toby has a red ___.
desafios.explicacion_error: «A small brown dog with a red collar».

desafios.texto: Violeta Parra (1917–1967) was a Chilean singer, composer and artist. She travelled around Chile collecting traditional songs. She also made colourful embroidered pictures called «arpilleras». Her song «Gracias a la vida» is known around the world.
desafios.enunciado: Ordena las palabras para formar la pregunta.
desafios.pista: Pregunta en pasado: What + did + sujeto + verbo.
desafios.explicacion_error: What did Violeta Parra collect?

desafios.texto: LOST DOG – Have you seen Toby? He is a small brown dog with a red collar. He got lost near Plaza Ñuñoa on Saturday. If you find him, please call 9 1234 5678. Reward!
desafios.enunciado: ¿Cuál es el propósito del aviso?
alternativas: pedir ayuda para encontrar al perro
desafios.explicacion_error: Pide ayuda para encontrar a Toby.

desafios.texto:
From: Diego  To: Ms. Rojas  Subject: Homework
Dear Ms. Rojas, I couldn't send my essay yesterday because the internet was down at home. I have attached it now. I'm sorry for the delay. Best regards, Diego
desafios.enunciado: Why did Diego write the email?
alternativas: to send his essay late and apologise
desafios.pista: Lee la razón y lo que adjunta.
desafios.explicacion_error: Envía su ensayo atrasado y se disculpa.

desafios.texto:
From: Diego  To: Ms. Rojas  Subject: Homework
Dear Ms. Rojas, I couldn't send my essay yesterday because the internet was down at home. I have attached it now. I'm sorry for the delay. Best regards, Diego
desafios.enunciado: ¿Verdadero, falso o no se menciona?

elementos.texto: Diego sent the essay on time.

desafios.explicacion_error: Se cayó internet y se disculpa; no lo envió a tiempo; no dice el tema.

desafios.texto:
From: Diego  To: Ms. Rojas  Subject: Homework
Dear Ms. Rojas, I couldn't send my essay yesterday because the internet was down at home. I have attached it now. I'm sorry for the delay. Best regards, Diego
desafios.enunciado: Une cada expresión con su función en el email.
desafios.pista: Piensa en la estructura de un email formal.
desafios.explicacion_error: Saludo, causa, disculpa y despedida.

desafios.enunciado: What was the result of the ban?

objetivo_oficial: OA 16: Escribir usando funciones del nivel: hábitos pasados (used to), acciones pasadas que continúan en el presente (present perfect), cláusulas relativas, voz pasiva y conectores como although o so that.

desafios.enunciado: When I was a child, I ___ play in the park every day.
desafios.explicacion_error: «I used to play» expresa un hábito pasado.

desafios.enunciado: She has ___ in Concepción since 2020.
desafios.explicacion_error: «She has lived» (present perfect).

desafios.enunciado: ¿Qué oración describe un hábito del pasado?
alternativas: My grandfather used to ride a horse to school.
My grandfather is riding a horse.
My grandfather will ride a horse.
My grandfather rides a horse now.
desafios.explicacion_error: «Used to» indica algo que se hacía antes.

desafios.enunciado: The girl ___ won the contest is my cousin.
desafios.explicacion_error: «The girl who won…»: relativo para personas.

desafios.enunciado: This is the house ___ I was born.
desafios.explicacion_error: «The house where I was born».

desafios.enunciado: ¿Present perfect o pasado simple?

elementos.texto: We went to Arica last year.

desafios.pista: Las marcas de tiempo definido (yesterday, last year) van con pasado simple.
desafios.explicacion_error: Have/has + participio es present perfect; went y saw, pasado simple.

desafios.enunciado: Empanadas ___ in many Chilean homes on September 18th.
desafios.explicacion_error: «Empanadas are eaten»: voz pasiva en presente.

desafios.enunciado: Ordena la oración en voz pasiva.
desafios.explicacion_error: The bridge was built in 1990.

desafios.enunciado: Une cada inicio con su final.
pares: The book which you lent me
desafios.pista: Revisa el sentido y la gramática.
desafios.explicacion_error: since + punto de partida; relativo «which» para cosas; voz pasiva «is exported».

desafios.enunciado: ___ it was raining, we went to the beach.
desafios.explicacion_error: «Although» introduce un contraste: llovía, pero fuimos.

desafios.enunciado: I'm saving money so ___ I can buy a bike.
desafios.explicacion_error: «So that» expresa finalidad.

desafios.enunciado: ¿Qué oración está bien escrita?
alternativas: I not have seen that film yet.
I haven't saw that film yet.
I haven't seen that film yet.
I didn't seen that film yet.
desafios.explicacion_error: «Haven't seen» es la forma correcta.

desafios.enunciado: Elige la mejor forma de unir: «The museum is in Santiago. It has a famous painting.»
alternativas: The museum where is in Santiago has a famous painting.
The museum, it is in Santiago, has a famous painting.
The museum who is in Santiago has a famous painting.
The museum, which is in Santiago, has a famous painting.
desafios.explicacion_error: «Which» introduce información adicional sobre el museo.

desafios.enunciado: Escucha y elige la oración que oíste.

audio.texto: The new library was opened last month.

alternativas: The new library opened me last month.
The new library has been closed.
The new library is opening next month.
The new library was opened last month.
desafios.explicacion_error: Dice «was opened last month»: voz pasiva en pasado.

desafios.enunciado: ¿Qué función cumple cada oración?

elementos.texto: We used to live in Temuco.
The letters were sent by post.

desafios.pista: used to / have + participio / be + participio.
desafios.explicacion_error: Used to: hábitos; present perfect: experiencias; be + participio: procesos.
